rows.en: ...I've seen your report. It seems things are proceeding according to plan.
uncertain: Speaker ??? (rows 1-30) is hidden; by context (raised AI1, operator of Medius) it is Eldy Middi, kept as ??? per brief. No gendered reference to ??? used.

rows.en: Yes...
The Medius is ready for launch. And what of the pilot?
uncertain: 'Medius' kept as the in-universe short form of Medius Locus (JP uses [jp] here and in rows 54, 83, 88 contrasts both forms). Not in glossary as a separate entry.

rows.en: Already waiting at the rendezvous point. As far as getting there goes, AI1 and I can manage on our own.
uncertain: Kept source omission of subject in 'Already waiting...' (the pilot is waiting; referent clear from row 2).

rows.en: Mm.
So, Dr. Zapat. As expected, the pilots of the #機体名 will be...
uncertain: Rows 5-6 form one question split across two boxes; translated as a continuing sentence.

rows.en: #男姓名 and #女姓名... Is it really going to be those two?
uncertain: Placeholders #男姓名 / #女姓名 (full names) are NOT in the brief's placeholder list; kept verbatim. textfit counts them as 4 JP glyphs (64px) each, not their runtime width; row has spare room (2 lines used) so it should still fit, but the width is unverified.

rows.en: Of course. That is precisely what they were chosen for.
But...
Admittedly, their test results so far have been less than satisfactory.
But most of those failures stem from the TE Engine's insufficient output.
It is by no means that their abilities are lacking.
uncertain: Restored subject 'their abilities' ([jp]).

rows.en: Or is it that you have a guilty conscience?
Especially about #女姓名... She is your...
uncertain: #女姓名 placeholder kept verbatim; width counted as 64px by textfit, runtime width unverified (one line at 344px; would wrap to 2 lines if longer, still fits).

rows.en: I simply believe they are not a fitting match for that child.
uncertain: [jp] read as 'match' (could be partner or opponent for AI1; Mitar's 'handicap' reply in row 20 suggests opponents). 'a fitting match' keeps both readings.

rows.en: That child? You mean AI1?
...I see. After all, one could say you are the one who raised it.
...Why did you give the TE Engine to their unit instead?
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'their unit' = the protagonists' #機体名 (inferred from rows 19-21).

rows.en: I believe leaving its control to AI1 as well would produce far better results.
uncertain: [jp] = control of the TE Engine; rendered 'its control'.

rows.en: Call it a handicap. As things stand, the match is too uneven.
Besides, AI1 as it is now could never understand the DFC system, could it?
Control by feeling... It's preposterous.
Still, #女愛称's data will be valuable to AI1. Though you may not like it.
...No. For AI1 and Lasmunanium to show their true power, a complete TE Engine is essential.
On that matter, I have no choice but to leave it to them and to you, Doctor.
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'them'; inferred to be the two pilots (rows 6-11), but could be the unnamed group of rows 28/32. Kept neutral.

rows.en: One last thing... The main targets are those two battleships, correct?
Yes. The Nadesico B and the Nahel Argama...
According to their scenario, the deterrent forces will gather on those two ships.
uncertain: [jp]: 'their' = an unnamed group Mitar works with; referent not settled in scene, kept as 'their'. [jp] rendered 'deterrent forces'.

rows.en: If you keep watch on them, you should meet all sorts of subjects to gather data from.
uncertain: Subject restored as 'you' (Eldy is the one going after the ships per rows 26/30). [jp] rendered 'keep watch on them'.

rows.en: Understood. I'll make contact with the closer of the two first. Well then, Doctor...
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'the nearest' (nearest of the two ships / targets); referent inferred.

rows.en: Yes, I hope for good results... No, never mind that. Just prove to me that my theory was correct.
uncertain: Mitar starts a wish then retracts it; 'I hope for good results...' kept as the broken-off clause.

rows.en: You see, I have no intention of going along with them to the very end.
uncertain: [jp] = same unnamed group as row 28; kept 'them'.

rows.en: ...Do you have a moment, #男愛称?
What do you want?
Don't play dumb. I mean the test just now. Why didn't you follow my instructions?
I gave you the predicted counterattack pattern data for the drones, didn't I?
Result: all targets downed. Our time improved by 8 seconds. You have a problem with that?
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'all targets downed' (the targets were drones, row 36). Subject 'Our time' restored.

rows.en: That's not it. I'm asking why you went off on your own... I want to know the reason.
Do I need to explain?
Obviously! I can't stand you running tests like this from now on.
uncertain: Subject restored: 'I can't stand you running tests...' ([jp] = being done to her by him).

rows.en: We have to deliver exactly the results Dr. Zapat wants.
The results that man wants, huh...
Anyway, stop ignoring my instructions, okay?
I do take them into account.
uncertain: Subject restored 'I' ([jp]).

rows.en: Oh, I see. Just into account, huh.
So the ex-special forces pilot doesn't put any stock in what I say.
uncertain: Mocking honorific [jp] conveyed by 'So the ex-special forces pilot...'; gender-neutral.

rows.en: That's not it. It's just...
Just... what?
I thought that if it had been real combat, we'd have been shot down.
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'we' (both pilots share the unit).

rows.en: ...All I need is for you to focus on tuning the TE Engine's output.
I'll handle the piloting and fighting of the #機体名.
W-well, excuse me! I don't have any real combat experience anyway!
But you know, someday I'll become the pilot of the Medius...!
What's wrong?
N-nothing. Sorry, but could you go get me some water?
uncertain: Direction: Hugo asking Aqua -> 'could you go get me some water?'.

rows.en: H-hey, now! Why should I have to do that!?
...Please.
uncertain: [jp] direction: Hugo asking Aqua -> '...Please.'

rows.en: F-fine, I get it. Water's what you want, right? Water.
Yeah...
Ngh...! And I'd been doing fine for a while now...
uncertain: Subject restored 'I' (thought).

rows.en: Here, your water.
Sorry for the trouble...
Hey, that... What kind of medicine is that?
Just...... cold medicine.
Hmm. A cold, huh? So you've got a delicate side after all.
......Is that a problem?
Not really.
...Somehow... it's finally settling down.
uncertain: Kept omission: subject of [jp] not named in source; rendered 'it' (his condition/symptoms).

rows.en: Hurry up and get better, okay? I couldn't stand it if you gave it to me.
uncertain: Restored: 'if you gave it to me' ([jp], the cold).

rows.en: What about you? Don't you catch cold, dressed in something like a swimsuit?
I-it's not a swimsuit! It's a DFC suit, a DFC suit!
I know.
Geez...! It's not like I wear this outfit because I enjoy it, either.
But you've grown kind of fond of it, haven't you?
Yeah, yeah, I can even get in the bath wearing it...
Hey, that's not it!
What!? That was an explosion!
It came from the hangar!
Don't tell me it's the #機体名!?
uncertain: Kept the source's ambiguity: Hugo only asks whether the explosion involves the #機体名 (moving or blown up). Rendered 'Don't tell me it's the #機体名!?'; Aqua's reply in row 82 ('we're not even in it') suggests he means it launched or moved.

rows.en: What are you talking about? We're not even in it!
Then is it the Medius Locus...!?
That's even less possible! A pilot hasn't even been chosen for it yet!
rows.notes: Passive 'A pilot hasn't even been chosen' for [jp] (no subject in the source).
uncertain: Kept omission: who picks the pilot isn't stated, so I used the passive.

rows.en: Anyway, we're going to the Doctor!
rows.notes: [jp]: Hugo is pulling Aqua along, so 'we're going'.

rows.en: Ngh! So the hangar hatch has been smashed!
rows.notes: Mitar is the one behind the theft (see row 101), so his reaction is staged.
uncertain: Kept omission: who smashed the hatch is not said, so I used the passive.

rows.en: Doctor, what happened!?
The Medius... It seems the Medius Locus has been stolen by someone!
uncertain: [jp] -> 'stolen by someone' (thief unknown; no gender).

rows.notes: Speechless reaction; the source body is just '!'.

rows.en: N-no way...! Who on earth would do this!?
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Who on earth would do this!?' (the verb was added, since the source omits it).

rows.en: I'm sorry, but I need you two to go after the Medius at once.
rows.notes: [jp] = Hugo and Aqua -> 'you two'.

rows.en: If it falls into enemy hands, the consequences will be dire...!
Th-that's right...!
If someone misuses the Lasmunanium, something like the Devil Gundam Incident a year ago could happen again...!
rows.notes: [jp] is a passive with no agent -> 'If someone misuses'.
uncertain: Name: the Devil Gundam incident is written 'Devil Gundam Incident' with a capital I. That's my choice; the glossary only lists 'Devil Gundam'.
Lasmunanium spelled per the glossary (TV Tropes alt 'Lazmunanium').

rows.en: Devil... Gundam......!
Understood, Doctor! We'll get the Medius back with our own hands, no matter what!
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'no matter what'.

rows.en: Good. I'll have the #機体名 readied for launch at once.
If need be, you may destroy the Medius.
Y... Yes!
rows.notes: Aqua hesitates after being told she may destroy the Medius.

rows.en: I'm counting on you both.
rows.notes: [jp]: Mitar is asking the pair -> 'I'm counting on you both'.

rows.en: Yes... I am truly counting on you... Heh heh heh heh...
rows.notes: [jp] in a thought. It echoes row 100 with sinister intent.
uncertain: Interpreted [jp] as a repeat of 'I'm counting on you' (Mitar's real plan). Laugh [jp] rendered as 'Heh heh heh heh...'.

rows.en: Captain, the ship will shortly be on course for atmospheric entry.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the ship'. The ship is presumably the Nahel Argama (Bright, Torres, the ZZ crew).
uncertain: Ship not named in the line; inferred from the speakers.

rows.en: Understood. All hands, Level 2 battle stations... Keep the mobile suits ready to launch at any time.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Level 2 battle stations'.
uncertain: Term: [jp] is not in the glossary. Chose 'Level 2 battle stations' (alternatives: 'Condition Two'). Other slices should use the same term.

rows.en: No way, seriously!? You're gonna send us out!?
rows.notes: [jp]: Elle is asking Bright (the one ordering) -> 'You're gonna send us out!?'

rows.en: The enemy we're chasing is planning to go down to Earth too, right!?
rows.notes: [jp] = the enemy is heading to Earth just like the ship.

rows.en: That's right.
Then why now, of all times...
Now is precisely the time.
Yeah, yeah. If it's a bad time for us, it's a bad time for the enemy too...
rows.notes: [jp] -> a bad moment for us.

rows.en: So that makes it our chance to strike.
Ooh, impressive. Spoken like a true ex-captain.
rows.notes: [jp]: Beecha was formerly the Argama's acting captain (Gundam ZZ).

rows.en: Don't tease me. I'm just relieved that heavy load is finally off my shoulders.
Same goes for you guys, right, Torres?
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'you guys, ... Torres' (Torres and the others, including Saegusa who answers in 116).

rows.en: Honestly, when you were made captain, I wondered how it'd turn out... but we somehow made it out alive.
Looking back now, I'm grateful to you.
Yeah. You really did a great job.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'You really did a great job' (addressed to Beecha).

rows.en: Wh-why, it was nothing, really...
It seems my judgment was not mistaken after all...
By the way, Bright, does this mean you can stay on as captain full-time now?
rows.notes: [jp] rendered as plain 'Bright' (no honorific), as is usual in English Gundam translations. Same in rows 132 and 152.
uncertain: Honorific choice: [jp] -> 'Bright' (could be 'Captain Bright'/'Mr. Bright'). This should be kept consistent across slices.

rows.en: Yes. The postwar negotiations with the Baam side have settled down for now.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the Baam side'.

rows.en: Besides... frankly, I'd rather sit here than deal with the bigwigs.
So what's going to happen to Little Baam in the end?
uncertain: Name: [jp] is not in the glossary and not in the local akurasu dump; neo-akurasu was unreachable (502). Used 'Little Baam' (English Wikipedia's Tosho Daimos article). Please add it to the glossary. Same in rows 129 and 142.

rows.en: Led by Erika, leader of the Baam peace faction...
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Erika' (the glossary says female; no pronoun used).

rows.en: ...it will move from the Moon to the Mars sphere until things in the Earth Sphere settle down.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'from the Moon to the Mars sphere'. [jp] -> 'Earth Sphere'.
uncertain: The subject of row 124 (Little Baam / its people) carries over from rows 122-123.

rows.en: Move? You mean with a Bison Jump?
rows.notes: Mondo garbles [jp] as [jp]; rendered as the English mishearing 'Bison Jump', and Iino corrects him in row 126.
uncertain: Malapropism: 'Bison Jump' is my localisation of [jp] (literally 'Basun').

rows.en: It's Boson Jump. Boson Jump.
Oh, right, that. Are they gonna use that Boson Jump?
rows.notes: Implied subject 'they' = Little Baam / the Baam.

rows.en: What are you talking about? Something that huge can't fit through a Chulip.
rows.notes: [jp] = Little Baam. [jp] = Chulip (glossary/decisions).

rows.en: Besides, Little Baam has a warp drive built in.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'warp drive'.

rows.en: Ahh, I get it. No wonder it suddenly showed up right near the Moon at the start.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Ahh, I get it'.
uncertain: [jp] is read as 'at the start' (when Little Baam first appeared in the story).

rows.en: You're only figuring that out now?
Bright, the results of Ple and Ple Two's checkups are in.
rows.notes: Ple / Ple Two per the glossary (not 'Puru').

rows.en: How did they turn out?
Nothing's wrong with them. They say there's no need to move them to the hospital on La Vie en Rose.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the hospital on La Vie en Rose' (the supply ship).
uncertain: Kept omission: 'They say' stands in for the unnamed source of the medical opinion ([jp]).

rows.en: I see... That battle cost us a great deal, but...
At least we were able to save those kids. That's some consolation.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'those kids' (gender-neutral, true to the source).

rows.en: Yes...
And what about Judau?
He was overjoyed about Ple and Ple Two, but... I guess he's still...
rows.notes: [jp]… left trailing.
uncertain: Kept omission: Leina breaks off ('he's still...'), implying Judau still hasn't recovered or is still down. The trailing-off is kept on purpose.

rows.en: No wonder. He's the one who was worn down most by the fight with Haman Karn...
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'No wonder'. [jp] -> 'Haman Karn' (full name, as in the source).

rows.en: Yeah...
rows.notes: Iino answers Bright's remark.

rows.en: Before the battle to liberate Little Baam, when the Federation and Neo Zeon called a truce...
rows.notes: Leads into row 143, where the subject 'he' = Judau ([jp]).
uncertain: [jp] -> 'the battle to liberate Little Baam' (event name not in the glossary).

rows.en: ...he was so happy, thinking the fighting might finally be over.
Yeah. But... in the end, Haman and Glemy still came after us...
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'came after us'.

rows.en: And after that, Giganos declares war, right? Anybody would be fed up, not just Judau.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'not just Judau'.

rows.en: It's nothing new, but the Federation brass really do work people to the bone, don't they?
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the Federation brass'.

rows.en: Tell me about it. Ordering us down to Earth to escort a new-weapons transport unit...
rows.notes: Implied subject 'us' (the crew) for the escort order.

rows.en: So it's settled. We're definitely getting dragged into the war with Giganos for real now.
Don't complain. You must have known it would come to this sooner or later.
Well, that's true, but...
Besides, other Federation units are being thrown into the Giganos war one after another too. We are all in the same boat.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'We are all in the same boat.'

rows.en: Bright, isn't the Nadesico going to help us out?
They're away from the Earth Sphere on a separate mission. They likely won't join the Giganos war until later.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'likely'.

rows.en: I see...
If I remember right, the Nadesico's former captain... passed away, right...?
rows.notes: [jp] = the Nadesico's former captain (in canon Yurika Misumaru, presumed dead in Prince of Darkness). Roux does not name them, so I added no name and no pronoun.
uncertain: Gender: the source gives none; I avoided a pronoun. Ending 'passed away, right...?' for [jp]…

rows.en: Yeah. For a while there were rumors that it was the Titans' doing.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the Titans' doing'.

rows.en: During the Lizard War, it seems the Nadesico earned quite a grudge from those guys.
rows.notes: [jp] = the Titans (row 156). [jp] -> 'Lizard War' (glossary: Lizard War (Jovian War)).
uncertain: Referent: 'those guys' = the Titans (inferred from row 156).

rows.en: But then the Titans themselves were wiped out in the Gryps Conflict...
uncertain: Name: the source says [jp] (Gryps War); the glossary entry is [jp] = 'Gryps Conflict'. I used 'Gryps Conflict' for consistency. Please confirm.

rows.en: So in the end, the word is that the Nadesico captain's death was probably just an accident.
rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the word is'.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Still, those Giganos guys... When did they manage to get that much military strength ready?
The lunar cities that preceded the Giganos Empire had a great many Metal Worker plants.
They used them to mass-produce Metal Armor while the Baam and Neo Zeon wars were going on.
So basically, they just sat back and grabbed the best part for themselves?
uncertain: Free rendering of oishii toko-dori (reaping the gains while others fight); Bright's 'No' in 165 confirms the sense.

rows.en: No. Even before declaring independence, Giganos was allied with the Neo Zeon forces and aiding them.
On top of that, when the Neo Zeon forces descended to Earth a few months ago...
I hear Giganos sent a Metal Armor unit down along with them.
But the bigger problem than that is...
The mass driver, right?
Yes. It takes far less effort than a colony drop... and yet it can instill the same level of fear in the Federation.
Furthermore, the leader of Giganos, Marshal Guiltorre...
is a man who warned that the Federation's Earth supremacism was destroying Earth's environment.
uncertain: Continues Bright's sentence from 171, so it starts lowercase with no subject restated; 'Earth supremacism' for chikyuu shijou shugi is my own rendering, not in the glossary.

rows.en: And he sees Earth as a sanctuary that must be protected... He is proclaiming that Ereism is in peril.
uncertain: Name question: [jp] is not in the glossary. Used 'Ereism' (the Gundam UC romanization I found on a wiki via search). Alternative spelling: 'Elezm'. Not checked on akurasu.net.

rows.en: And if Neo Zeon remnants or the hawks exiled from Mokuren were to side with him...
uncertain: Used 'Mokuren' (short form of the glossary's 'Mokuren (Jovian Federation)'). Inferred that 'him' is Guiltorre (source: 'side with' has no stated object).

rows.en: this war will be a repeat of the Lizard War and the Gryps Conflict.
uncertain: Continues 174, so it starts lowercase. Source says [jp] (War); I used the glossary's 'Gryps Conflict' (its entry is for [jp]) to stay consistent. Used 'Lizard War' from the glossary's 'Lizard War (Jovian War)'.

rows.en: Captain, enemy readings ahead on our course!
Good, we've caught up to them! All hands, Level 1 battle stations! Mobile suit teams, launch at once!
uncertain: Read dai-1-shu sentou haichi as 'Level 1 battle stations'. Inferred that 'them' is the enemy reported in 177.

rows.en: Roger!
..."Operation Overlord"... So the Federation is finally going to strike back at them?
uncertain: Restored the subject as 'the Federation' (source has none). Inferred that 'them' is Giganos from the earlier scene; the source only says [jp].

rows.en: Yes. And in connection with it, the Federation forces have sent me a request for support.
By support, you mean... Getter Robo?
No, not only that.
My Saotome Institute, your Institute of Space Science, Dr. Umon...
And the Photon Power Laboratory, Mutropolis, the Science Fortress Laboratory and others...
They have asked the institutes involved with super robots to work together more closely than ever and assist the military.
uncertain: Added 'They have asked' to match the source's passive 'a request came'. [jp] is not in the glossary; I used 'super robots'.
Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: And the one behind this call is Commander Koichiro Misumaru of the Federation Space Force...
uncertain: [jp] rendered as 'Commander'. Federation Space Force ([jp]) is not in the glossary.

rows.en: Surely you've heard his name too, Doctor?
Yes.
To deal with the fight against the Giganos forces and what lies ahead, Operation Overlord included...
Commander Misumaru is planning to form a new super robot unit centered on the Nahel Argama and Nadesico B.
uncertain: [jp] rendered as 'super robot unit'.

rows.en: I see... In the Baam War and the Devil Gundam incident, their teamwork was a major key to resolving things.
uncertain: Inferred referent: 'their teamwork' ([jp]) means the cooperation between the super robot groups and ships just named. The source leaves this open.

rows.en: On my end, too, the battles with the Dinosaur Empire, the Mycenae Empire and the Demon Empire are over...
uncertain: Ends with '...' and runs on into 195, which starts with 'So'.

rows.en: So I intend to send the Getter Team to that super robot unit as soon as the new Getter Robo is completed.
...Understood. We too will offer you whatever cooperation we can.
I'm grateful. Please do.
uncertain: Direction for [jp]: Saotome is asking Umon to follow through on his offer of help, so I wrote 'I'm grateful. Please do.'

rows.en: One more thing... Lately, those UFOs have been appearing more and more often.
uncertain: [jp]UFO rendered as 'those UFOs' (the ones both scientists already know about).

rows.en: I think it would be wise for you to stay fully on your guard over there as well.
Understood. Well then...
...Operation Overlord, and the founding of a super robot unit...
It's true we must get ourselves ready before they make any concrete move, but...
uncertain: Kept the source's 'they' ([jp]) unresolved. From context it is probably the UFO aliens (or possibly the Federation); Umon's thought does not say.

rows.en: Hello, Dr. Umon. I'm Koji Kabuto.
Oh, I'm glad you came, Koji. Has it been about a year since you were last in Japan?
No... Actually, I came back once about six months ago.
I came to help Ryoma, Akira and the others fight the Dinosaur Empire and the Demon Empire.
uncertain: Restored 'I came' to finish the sentence begun in 205. [jp] = Ryoma (glossary en_short) and [jp] = Akira (Hibiki, glossary).

rows.en: But your Mazinger Z, if I recall...
uncertain: Kept Umon's trailing-off line as it is in the source.

rows.en: That time was a special case. It's back in the Robot Museum now.
I see. By the way, that TFO you flew here in... It's quite well made.
Thank you. That saucer is the fruit of my studies in America.
Because of it, though, the folks at Shirakaba Ranch mistook me for a UFO.
uncertain: The source is passive ('I was mistaken for a UFO'); kept 'mistook me', meaning Koji in his saucer.

rows.en: Danbei, eh... He's quite the UFO researcher, you know.
uncertain: [jp] rendered as 'Danbei' (glossary en_short); the honorific was dropped.

rows.en: He seems a little worked up over all the UFO sightings lately.
That's just it, Doctor. The reason I came here is...
I wanted to hear about the UFOs that have been appearing lately around this Institute of Space Science and TOKYO JUPITER.
I don't mind, but... What for?
Well... Actually, I'd like to try making contact with them.
Contact...?
Yes. Many people on Earth feel prejudice and fear toward aliens.
But I want to believe that we can come to understand them through peaceful talks.
And I think that from now on, Earth should actively engage with other planets.
But that will be a difficult thing, Koji.
I know.
Can humanity, still fighting among itself, deal peacefully with other planets...? Honestly, I have my doubts too.
But we have a wonderful precedent: we succeeded in making peace with the Baam.
I'm never going to give up.
I see...
If only the alien peoples we are going to meet thought the way you do...
uncertain: Restored 'we' as the subject (meaning humanity).

rows.en: Father!
uncertain: [jp] rendered as 'Father' to match Daisuke's polite register.

rows.en: What is it, Daisuke?
There's something I need to talk to you about...
Before that, let me introduce you. This is Koji Kabuto...
The pilot of Mazinger Z, who helped bring down Dr. Hell and the Mycenae Empire.
Never mind that. I have something important to tell you.
uncertain: Free rendering of [jp] ('Never mind that').

rows.en: Hey, hey, so you're just gonna ignore me!?
Daisuke, you're being rude to Koji.
This is no time for that. Father... Have you seen the moon?
No... At this hour, it should have only just risen... Wait, Daisuke. Don't tell me the moon's color is...!?
Yes. It's glowing a fiery red.
uncertain: The source has no subject; restored 'It' (the moon), which 238 settles.

rows.en: What...?!
The moon...? What about the moon?
A red moon... the signal fire for their sortie. ...You should contact the Earth Federation Forces. They will attack, without a doubt.
uncertain: 'You should contact' - Daisuke is addressing his father (row 238-241 exchange); 'they' ([jp]) is left unnamed as in the source.

rows.en: Them? Attack? What on earth are you talking about?
...You'd better stay out of this one. If you underestimate them, you'll get hurt.
They're nothing like the enemies you once fought in Mazinger Z.
What...?! What's that supposed to mean?
That's enough, Daisuke.
...Koji, you must be tired from your long journey. Please, get some rest today.
Y-yes, sir...
Daisuke Umon... Just who is this guy...?
So the time has finally come... But I don't want to pilot it... not that thing, ever again...
uncertain: [jp] ('that thing') left unnamed as in the source (it is Grendizer, not yet revealed).

rows.en: I don't want to pilot that thing ever again...!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryoma! Hayato! Benkei!
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Reduce Medius Locus's HP to 70% or less
rows.notes: Victory condition list entry.

rows.en: 1. All allies destroyed
rows.notes: Defeat condition list entry.

rows.en: ...This is Wolf 1. I've reached the designated position.
uncertain: Callsign 'Wolf 1' (urufu 1) not in glossary; transliterated as 'Wolf 1'.

rows.en: TMC here, roger. Stand by until the Medius is ready to launch.
uncertain: 'TMC' kept as-is: the test control station's callsign, not in the glossary and the expansion is not known. 'Medius' (short form) given the article 'the Medius'; the full name is 'Medius Locus'.

rows.en: Wolf 1, roger.
uncertain: Hugo's callsign here is 'Wolf 1' (the glossary lists 'Wolf 1' as a nickname of Albero; in this scene it is clearly Hugo's callsign). Reused for both s00r00:210 and :233; it works as a reply to either.

rows.en: Also, adjust the TE Engine's output with the DFC system, not manually.
Huh? Nobody said anything like that in the briefing...
This is Dr. Zapat's order.
uncertain: Hakase is rendered 'Dr. Zapat' (glossary: Mitar Zapat; position Professor/General).

rows.en: Then please give me some time. I'll recalibrate the system.
I can't allow that. The test will begin at the scheduled time.
But that's...!
I'd say he wants to see us improvise. If you don't follow instructions, it'll hurt your rating.
uncertain: 'he' = Dr. Zapat, the one who gave the order (glossary: male); the JP has no subject. The JP leaves open whose evaluation suffers; I wrote 'your rating' (aimed at Aqua, since the engine output is her job). 'our rating' is also possible.

rows.en: Look who's talking. You don't even care what the doctor thinks of you.
...I wouldn't say that.
It's easy for you. You've got a track record. But me...
If you're worried about your rating, then do your own job properly.
That's my line. You're going to follow my instructions, got it?
If they're more accurate than my own judgment.
There you go again! Why do you think I'm riding in this machine with you!?
To adjust that troublesome engine's output.
Right, right, adjusting the TE Engine is a lot of work, so...
Wait, that's not the only reason!
You just focus on adjusting the output. Leave everything else to me.
Don't be ridiculous! I'm not just your tagalong!
Then prove it. Keep the output in the Blue Zone.
uncertain: 'Blue Zone' / 'Yellow Zone' ([jp]/[jp]) are not in the glossary; capitalised as gauge-zone names.

rows.en: I-I know that!
TMC to Wolf 1. We are now launching the Medius.
uncertain: Uses the same article as row 400 ('the Medius').

rows.en: Medius Locus... It seems to move fairly well even unmanned.
Yeah.
If we lose this mock battle, we won't be able to face the doctor.
...I'm not doing this for that man's sake.
rows.notes: thought

rows.en: ...To Wolf 1. The exercise begins now.
uncertain: [jp]: military 'commence the scenario', written as 'The exercise begins now'.

rows.en: Roger.
This will also test the Lasmunanium's self-regeneration function. So there's no need to hold back.
uncertain: 'Lasmunanium' per the glossary (TV Tropes spells it 'Lazmunanium').

rows.en: You're saying it's fine if I shoot down the Medius?
If you're capable of it, that is.
Hmph...
Also, I've made a slight change to the plan. The Medius Locus's weapons are loaded with live ammo too.
What!? Then it's no different from real combat!
Correct. One wrong move, and you two will die.
What's wrong? Are you not confident, #女姓名?
uncertain: The placeholder #女姓名 (female lead's full name) is kept verbatim. It is NOT in the brief's placeholder list or in textfit's PLACEHOLDER_PX, so textfit counted it as 64 px. It sits alone on line 2 (104 px), so even a long full name still fits. Please confirm the build expands it.

rows.en: No, sir! I'll do it! I'll show you I can!
Then I look forward to good results.
...As if I'd get cold feet over something like this...!
rows.notes: thought

rows.en: Let's go, #女愛称!
Got it!
#女愛称! The output's right at the edge of the Yellow Zone!
I've almost got it into the Blue Zone! Put some distance between us and the enemy for now!
uncertain: [jp] = the opposing unit (the Medius Locus), written as 'the enemy'.

rows.en: Don't be stupid! If we pull back now, we're the ones who'll get taken down!
Just follow my instructions! I'll send you the optimal MP data!
uncertain: 'MP data' kept as in the JP ([jp]); it is not in the glossary, and the expansion is unknown.

rows.en: No, I'm pressing on!
H-hey, wait! #男愛称!!
Damage check... This much is nothing to worry about.
But the engine output is unstable.
That's because your piloting is so rough! Use the MP data I picked for you!
This isn't a simulation. I can't do everything by the textbook.
What did you say!?
...Those two never change.
Perhaps there's a problem with the pairing after all?
I chose them for their aptitude. I knew from the start that their personalities clash.
uncertain: The source body has a stray '[jp]@[jp]' at the end (a script typo); I ignored it and the en has no bracket.

rows.en: But as things stand, they won't be able to beat AI1's results.
Well... we shall see about that.
The way this feels, we'll be fine.
uncertain: The subject is inferred as 'we' (the pair in the unit); the JP has none.

rows.en: Don't be stupid. The engine output still isn't stable.
!? #男愛称, the Medius is moving strangely...
uncertain: [jp]… (trailing off) is rendered 'the Medius is moving strangely...'. 'strangely' comes from the next line ('That's odd'); the JP itself breaks off.

rows.en: That's odd. Machine trouble?
Dr. Zapat, a malfunction has occurred in the Medius Locus's control system.
And the Lasmunanium's self-regeneration function?
It's barely working.
uncertain: The subject 'It' = the self-regeneration function from row 464.

rows.en: ...So only AI1 can fully control that thing after all.
What should we do?
Stop the battle. Recall the #機体名 and the Medius Locus at once.
uncertain: The #機体名 placeholder is given the article 'the'. If the unit name already reads well without one, drop 'the'.

rows.en: Yes, sir.
Once we're back at the institute, we'll install AI1 in the Medius. Notify her in advance.
uncertain: [jp] 'her' is kept from the source. From context it is Eldy (AI1's developer, female per the glossary), but she is not named here.

rows.en: Understood.
...#男愛称, we've been ordered to return. Looks like the Medius really did have machine trouble.
Ngh...!
uncertain: The pained grunt [jp]……[jp] is written as 'Ngh...!'.

rows.en: ...It's nothing.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: Is the medicine wearing off...? No, that can't be...
rows.notes: thought

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: ...If the Medius Locus had been in perfect condition...
rows.notes: thought

rows.en: If that thing had a pilot... a skilled "human" aboard, we might not have come out of it in one piece...
rows.notes: thought
uncertain: [jp] has no subject in the JP. I wrote 'we' (Hugo and Aqua share the machine); 'I' is also possible. [jp] is rendered with double quotes as "human".

rows.en: Don't overdo the tough act, #男姓名.
uncertain: #男姓名/#女姓名 (full-name placeholders) are not in textfit PLACEHOLDER_PX, so textfit counts them as 64px; re-checked with each expanded to 9 full-width glyphs (144px, length of the JP default full name): still FITS.
Mitar addresses the male lead by full name here (#男姓名), not the nickname; kept as in source.

rows.en: ...I'm not taking any more of your treatment.
It isn't treatment. It's an adjustment.
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'adjustment' (he is modified/cyborg); 'tune-up/maintenance' also possible.

rows.en: I still need you to do a great deal of work as the TE Absorber's test pilot...
That is why you need readjusting. Just suppressing your condition with medicine won't let you handle the unexpected.
uncertain: Object of [jp] is omitted in JP; supplied 'your condition' (his symptoms) from context.

rows.en: I'd much rather keep taking pills than be treated by you.
But that way, you will reach your limit sooner or later.
Even if I get treated, it's not like I'll stop needing the pills, right?
Correct. Your body is not like an ordinary human's, after all.
...Enough. Just hurry up and give me the pills.
Very well.
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.

rows.en: ...This is more than usual, isn't it?
Consider it a bonus. I am not a monster, after all. Besides, I would hate to lose a talent like you.
That's rich. You normally hand over only the bare minimum.
Stop mouthing off and take your medicine. Before your body stops moving.
...In that state, he could end up hindering the mission.
uncertain: [jp] = the male lead (just left); 'he' used because the glossary records the male lead (Hugo) as male and the placeholder is #男.

rows.en: Wouldn't it be better to force a readjustment on him?
uncertain: 'him' = the male lead, as in row 495.

rows.en: No... For the time being, he can stay as he is.
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.
uncertain: 'he' = the male lead, as in row 495.

rows.en: Because he's easier to tame that way?
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.
uncertain: 'he' = the male lead, as in row 495.

rows.en: Indeed. That medicine is the shackle on a wounded wolf.
A wolf? Surely you mean a whipped dog?
uncertain: [jp] (loser, lit. beaten dog) rendered 'whipped dog' to keep the wolf/dog contrast.

rows.en: ...So you've come. I trust no one saw you?
No one did. You needn't worry.
uncertain: [jp] answers 'I trust no one saw you?'; rendered as 'No one did' to keep the sense in English.

rows.en: I have seen your report. Things seem to be proceeding as planned.
Of course. And on your end?
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.

rows.en: I tested the Medius, but full control was impossible without AI1. Especially that particular Lasmunanium function.
uncertain: 'that particular Lasmunanium function' = [jp] (presumably self-regeneration, cf. row 464); not made explicit, as the source keeps it vague.

rows.en: Then... you will formally adopt my proposal?
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.

rows.en: Yes... I will have AI1 installed at once.
uncertain: Subject of [jp] omitted; 'I will have AI1 installed' (Mitar arranging it) inferred.

rows.en: Understood.
And that man?
uncertain: [jp] = unnamed man waiting at the rendezvous (row 3 reply); identity not given in this scene.

rows.en: You work quickly.
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.
uncertain: Speaker ??? is Eldy (hidden), kept ???.

rows.en: I had predicted the test results.
Now then, Dr. Zapat. About the pilots of the #機体名...
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'pilots' (plural: two people named in row 514).

rows.en: #男姓名 and #女姓名... Is it settled that those two will pilot it?
uncertain: #男姓名/#女姓名 (full-name placeholders) are not in textfit PLACEHOLDER_PX, so textfit counts them as 64px; re-checked with each expanded to 9 full-width glyphs (144px, length of the JP default full name): still FITS.
'pilot it' supplied for [jp] (settled as the crew of #機体名, per row 513).

rows.en: It is.
#男姓名 is a pilot with a defect...
uncertain: #男姓名/#女姓名 (full-name placeholders) are not in textfit PLACEHOLDER_PX, so textfit counts them as 64px; re-checked with each expanded to 9 full-width glyphs (144px, length of the JP default full name): still FITS.

rows.en: And #女姓名 is...
uncertain: #男姓名/#女姓名 (full-name placeholders) are not in textfit PLACEHOLDER_PX, so textfit counts them as 64px; re-checked with each expanded to 9 full-width glyphs (144px, length of the JP default full name): still FITS.

rows.en: She was your student, wasn't she? Do you feel guilty?
uncertain: [jp] = #女姓名 (female lead, glossary: Aqua, female); 'She' used.

rows.en: According to the Committee's scenario, the world's deterrent forces will gather on those two ships.
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'the Committee' (likely the Human Instrumentality Committee of the Eva side, but the source does not say so). 'the world's' added to [jp] for readability; [jp]2[jp] = Nadesico B and Nahel Argama (row 27).

rows.en: #男愛称! What have you been doing all this time?!
Do I need to answer that?
You certainly do! We agreed we'd hold a debrief together after the test!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'debrief' (also rows 533).

rows.en: Oh... Right, we did.
Honestly... I searched all over: the gunroom, the training room, your room...
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'gunroom' (naval junior officers' mess); not in glossary.

rows.en: You went inside my room?
A young maiden yet to be wed can't just go into a single man's room alone!
...You're surprisingly old-fashioned.
Well, excuse me. Anyway, where on earth did you go?
To see Dr. Zapat.
uncertain: Answer to 'where did you go?' rendered 'To see Dr. Zapat.' ([jp]).

rows.en: But we already gave our report together?
After that, I had some personal business with the doctor.
Hmmm...
...We're doing the debrief, right?
uncertain: Subject restored as 'We' (the debrief is the pair's).

rows.en: That's right. Why didn't you use the MP data I chose in that last battle?
uncertain: 'MP data' not in glossary; kept literal.

rows.en: Because there was no need to.
Y-you've got some nerve saying that! I believe I made the right choice!
True, it wasn't wrong. But it wasn't the best, either.
Oh, is that so!
So the elite pilot from special ops won't rely on instructions from a rookie like me!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'from special ops'; [jp] sarcasm carried by 'the elite pilot'.

rows.en: ...Let me remind you, I'm the one actually piloting the machine.
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.

rows.en: So I decide how to fight.
uncertain: [jp]: generic 'how to fight' kept (he pilots; the unit is shared).

rows.en: So you're telling me not to butt in during battle?
First, get used to adjusting the engine output with the DFC system. We'll talk after that.
...Fine. I'll show you I can adjust the engine output and give perfect instructions at the same time.
And someday, I'll be the pilot of the Medius...
uncertain: Subject omitted in JP; 'I' (Aqua) inferred: continues her row 544 and her stated goal of piloting the Medius.

rows.en: Ngh...?
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.

rows.en: What's wrong?
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.

rows.en: My body...!
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.
uncertain: Thought row (kind=thought); textfit CLI checks with dialogue brackets, same width.

rows.en: #男愛称?
rows.notes: Source body_jp ends with a stray '[jp]@[jp]' (raw line has '@[jp]' after the closing bracket); en written without it, build must keep the trailing '@[jp]' from jp.

rows.en: Sorry... Could you get me some water?
H-hey, now! Why should I have to do that?!
What is it? Why the serious face?
uncertain: Reacts to the male lead's '...Please' (row id 59) between 551 and 552.

rows.en: Oh, honestly, fine. Water, right? Just water.
